title: Private Idol Disc: Tokubetsu-hen: Kogal Daihyakka 100
native_title: プラドル ＤＩＳＣ 【特別編】 コギャル大百科１００
overview:
Special Edition: Kogal Encyclopedia 100

100 girls' worth of loose socks! If you want to know what's in right now, this is the only software for you!!

This special edition of the Private Idol Disc series is a digital photo book and database of 100 kogals in school uniforms and loose socks. Page through a gallery of faces, then open any girl's profile card with her birthday, blood type, height, measurements and shoe size, along with her photos and an interview video.

- Photo Hall: photo albums
- Encyclopedia: profiles and interview videos for all 100 girls
- Production credits
